whyLines: Whatever you magnify, you get more of.
A telescope never moved a mountain. It just filled your eyes with it.
Magnifying doesn't make God bigger. It makes Him bigger to you.
Mary said this while her whole life looked ruined.
Paul and Silas sang at midnight, in chains. The foundations moved after.
Jehoshaphat sent the worshippers out ahead of the army.
David lost everything at Ziklag, and strengthened himself in the Lord.
Praise is what you do before the walls come down, not after.
You will not out-think this. You can out-worship it.
The size of the storm never changed. The size of your God did.
You become what you behold.
Nothing gets smaller by staring at it. Look higher instead.
Worship is not a feeling you wait for. It is a thing you do first.
Whatever fills your eyes sets the size of your day.
He was already this big. Today you get to see it.
Job worshipped on the worst day of his life, before one thing was restored.
The disciples woke Jesus in the storm. He was bigger than it the whole time.
Habakkuk had no figs, no flock, no herd. He said he would rejoice anyway.
You are not talking yourself into anything. You are agreeing with what is.
Speak it out loud. Faith comes by hearing, and your own ears count.
Magnify Him first, and everything else finds its actual size.
This is not denial. It is putting the truth where your eyes are.
Peter looked at the wind and sank. He was looking at the wrong thing.
Every one of them magnified God before anything changed.

entries.attribute: The Lord my peace
entries.exaltation: You are my peace. You are the God who settles the storm.
entries.declaration: I am given power, love, and a sound mind by God, and my courage runs deep.
entries.verseText: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.

entries.attribute: The God who walks me through
entries.exaltation: You walk with me through the valley. I fear nothing there.
entries.declaration: I am filled with God's perfect love, and I rest in Him completely safe and held.
entries.verseText: There is no fear in love. But perfect love drives out fear, because fear has to do with punishment. The one who fears is not made perfect in love.

entries.attribute: The God I run into
entries.exaltation: You are my refuge. I run into Your name and I am safe.
entries.declaration: I declare Christ in me has overcome the world, so I take heart and stand tall.
entries.verseText: I have told you these things, so that in me you may have peace. In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.

entries.attribute: The God who covers me
entries.exaltation: You are my shield. You cover me on every side.
entries.declaration: I am alive with Christ living in me, and I face today with His courage.
entries.verseText: I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I now live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.

entries.attribute: The God who watches all night
entries.exaltation: You never sleep. You watch over me all night long.
entries.declaration: I declare God gives me the victory through Jesus Christ, and I stand on the winning side.
entries.verseText: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.nameOfGod: The Lord Who Goes Before Me
entries.attribute: The God already there
entries.exaltation: You go before me. You have already been where I am going.
entries.declaration: I am strong and courageous. The Lord walks beside me and never lets go.
entries.verseText: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or terrified because of them, for the LORD your God goes with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you.

entries.attribute: The God who does not move
entries.exaltation: You are my rock. You do not move, and neither does what You hold.
entries.declaration: I declare I am bold and steady, because the Lord is with me wherever I go.
entries.verseText: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God will be with you wherever you go.

entries.attribute: The God I am hidden in
entries.exaltation: You are my hiding place. I am hidden in You.
entries.declaration: I am righteous in Christ and bold as a lion, and I speak up when it matters.
entries.verseText: The wicked flee though no one pursues, but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

entries.attribute: The God underneath me
entries.exaltation: Underneath me are Your everlasting arms. You do not let go.
entries.declaration: I am redeemed. God calls me by name, and I walk into today unshaken.
entries.verseText: But now, this is what the LORD says—he who created you, Jacob, he who formed you, Israel: Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have summoned you by name; you are mine.

entries.attribute: The God who meets me here
entries.exaltation: You are the God of all comfort. You meet me exactly where I am.
entries.declaration: I am God's own child by the Spirit, and I come to my Father with full confidence.
entries.verseText: The Spirit you received does not make you slaves, so that you live in fear again; rather, the Spirit you received brought about your adoption to sonship. And by him we cry, 'Abba, Father.'

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Stills the Sea
entries.attribute: Lord over every storm
entries.exaltation: You speak, and the sea lies down. You are Lord over every storm.
entries.declaration: I declare I approach God's throne of grace with confidence and receive mercy and help now.
entries.verseText: Let us then approach God's throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

entries.attribute: The God whose armies answer
entries.exaltation: You are the Lord of Hosts. Heaven's armies answer to You.
entries.declaration: I am more than a conqueror through Christ. I walk into the big meeting already won.
entries.verseText: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

entries.attribute: The God who fights for me
entries.exaltation: You are my banner. You fight for me and I hold my peace.
entries.declaration: I am born of God. My faith overcomes the world, so I move with courage.
entries.verseText: For everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.

entries.attribute: The God who has never lost
entries.exaltation: You are my deliverer. You have never lost a battle.
entries.declaration: I declare the Lord is my light and my stronghold, so I see clearly and stand bold.
entries.verseText: The LORD is my light and my salvation—whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life—of whom shall I be afraid?

entries.attribute: The God whose peace is not the world's
entries.exaltation: You are the Prince of Peace. Your peace is not like the world's.
entries.declaration: I am held by the hand of God, and my hands are steady for today.
entries.verseText: For I am the LORD your God who takes hold of your right hand and says to you, Do not fear; I will help you.

entries.attribute: The God who finished it
entries.exaltation: You are the Lamb of God. You took it all, and it is finished.
entries.declaration: I declare it is finished, and I rest in grace that fully accepts me.
entries.verseText: When he had received the drink, Jesus said, 'It is finished.' With that, he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

entries.attribute: The God whose mercy is new
entries.exaltation: You are rich in mercy. Your mercy is new every morning.
entries.declaration: I am saved by grace through faith, and this gift from God is mine forever.
entries.verseText: For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God—not by works, so that no one can boast.

entries.attribute: The God who raises me up
entries.exaltation: You are the lifter of my head. You raise me up.
entries.declaration: I declare grace and truth came to me through Jesus, and I stand on His finished work.
entries.verseText: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.

entries.attribute: The God who bought me back
entries.exaltation: You are my Redeemer. You bought me at full price.
entries.declaration: I am redeemed by the blood of Jesus, forgiven completely, and the price is paid in full.
entries.verseText: In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, in accordance with the riches of God's grace

entries.attribute: The God whose grace is enough
entries.exaltation: You are the God of all grace. Your grace is more than enough.
entries.declaration: I declare God made me alive with Christ, and my slate is clean forever.
entries.verseText: When you were dead in your sins and in the uncircumcision of your flesh, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our sins, having canceled the charge of our legal indebtedness, which stood against us and condemned us; he has taken it away, nailing it to the cross.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Remembers No More
entries.attribute: The God who buried it
entries.exaltation: You remember my sin no more. You threw it into the sea.
entries.declaration: I am rescued and brought into the kingdom of the Son God loves, redeemed and forgiven.
entries.verseText: For he has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of the Son he loves, in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.

entries.attribute: The God who speaks for me
entries.exaltation: You are my Advocate. You speak for me before the Father.
entries.declaration: I declare God counts me righteous because I trust Him, not because I earn it.
entries.verseText: Now to the one who works, wages are not credited as a gift but as an obligation. However, to the one who does not work but trusts God who justifies the ungodly, their faith is credited as righteousness.

entries.attribute: The God who always intercedes
entries.exaltation: You are my High Priest. You always live to intercede for me.
entries.declaration: I am standing in this grace by faith, both feet planted in God's favor.
entries.verseText: through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we now stand. And we boast in the hope of the glory of God.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Casts It Far
entries.attribute: The God who removed it
entries.exaltation: You removed it as far as the east is from the west.
entries.declaration: I am justified freely by His grace. My right standing is a gift.
entries.verseText: and all are justified freely by his grace through the redemption that came by Christ Jesus.

entries.attribute: The God who washes me
entries.exaltation: You are the fountain opened for me. You wash me clean.
entries.declaration: I am the righteousness of God in Christ, and His holiness belongs to me now.
entries.verseText: God made him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

entries.attribute: The God who calls me righteous
entries.exaltation: You are the God who justifies. You call me righteous and it is so.
entries.declaration: I declare I am new in Christ, and the old has gone for good.
entries.verseText: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!

entries.attribute: The God who paid it all
entries.exaltation: You are my ransom. You paid what I could never pay.
entries.declaration: I am in Christ Jesus, fully cleared, fully accepted, and forever free before God.
entries.verseText: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus,

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Restores the Years
entries.attribute: The God who gives it back
entries.exaltation: You restore what was lost. You give back the years.
entries.declaration: I am strong in the grace of Christ Jesus. His strength is my supply.
entries.verseText: You then, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

entries.attribute: The God every chain answers
entries.exaltation: You are the Breaker. Every chain gives way at Your name.
entries.declaration: I am justified by faith, and I have peace with God through Jesus my Lord.
entries.verseText: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,

entries.attribute: The God who completes it
entries.exaltation: You are the author and the finisher. You complete what You began.
entries.declaration: I declare by the grace of God I am what I am, and that grace bears fruit.
entries.verseText: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and his grace to me was not without effect. No, I worked harder than all of them—yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.

entries.attribute: The God who sees ahead and provides
entries.exaltation: You are Jehovah Jireh. You see ahead and You provide.
entries.declaration: I am supplied from the riches of His glory, and every need I have is met.
entries.verseText: And my God will meet all your needs according to the riches of his glory in Christ Jesus.

entries.attribute: The God I lack nothing under
entries.exaltation: You are my Shepherd. I lack nothing.
entries.declaration: I declare God gave me His own Son, so He freely gives me all things.
entries.verseText: He who did not spare his own Son, but gave him up for us all—how will he not also, along with him, graciously give us all things?

entries.nameOfGod: The Giver of Every Good Gift
entries.attribute: The God who does not run out
entries.exaltation: Every good gift comes from You. You do not run out.
entries.declaration: I am rich in Christ, because He became poor to make me wealthy in every way.
entries.verseText: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sake he became poor, so that you through his poverty might become rich.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Opens His Hand
entries.attribute: The God who satisfies
entries.exaltation: You open Your hand and satisfy every living thing.
entries.declaration: I declare the Lord provides, and my supply is ready on the mountain before I arrive.
entries.verseText: So Abraham called that place The Lord Will Provide. And to this day it is said, 'On the mountain of the Lord it will be provided.'

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Sets a Table
entries.attribute: The God who prepares it Himself
entries.exaltation: You set a table for me. You prepare it Yourself.
entries.declaration: I am led by the Lord my shepherd, and everything I need is already mine.
entries.verseText: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.

entries.attribute: The God who is enough
entries.exaltation: You are my portion. You are more than enough.
entries.declaration: I am God's child and His heir. I step into my full inheritance today.
entries.verseText: So you are no longer a slave, but God's child; and since you are his child, God has made you also an heir.

entries.attribute: The God who meets every need
entries.exaltation: You supply all my need out of Your riches in glory.
entries.declaration: I am co-heir with Christ. Everything the Father owns is mine to steward.
entries.verseText: Now if we are children, then we are heirs—heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ, if indeed we share in his sufferings in order that we may also share in his glory.

entries.nameOfGod: The Owner of a Thousand Hills
entries.attribute: The God who is short of nothing
entries.exaltation: The cattle on a thousand hills are Yours. You are short of nothing.
entries.declaration: I declare my inheritance never perishes, spoils, or fades, and God keeps it safe for me.
entries.verseText: and into an inheritance that can never perish, spoil or fade. This inheritance is kept in heaven for you.

entries.attribute: The God who multiplies
entries.exaltation: You are the Lord of the harvest. You multiply what is sown.
entries.declaration: I am blessed abundantly, so I have all I need and abound in every good work.
entries.verseText: And God is able to bless you abundantly, so that in all things at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Rains Bread from Heaven
entries.attribute: The God who feeds me daily
entries.exaltation: You rain bread from heaven. You feed me morning by morning.
entries.declaration: I declare the blessing of the Lord makes me rich, and it comes with rest and joy.
entries.verseText: The blessing of the LORD brings wealth, without painful toil for it.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Fills the Empty Jars
entries.attribute: The God who fills till there is no room
entries.exaltation: You fill what is empty. You fill it until there is no room left.
entries.declaration: I am filled with every good thing from the Lord, and my table overflows today.
entries.verseText: The lions may grow weak and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.

entries.attribute: The God no one can shut out
entries.exaltation: You open doors no one can shut.
entries.declaration: I declare I seek God's kingdom first, so everything I need is added to me.
entries.verseText: But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Whose Blessing Adds No Sorrow
entries.attribute: The God who makes rich
entries.exaltation: Your blessing makes rich and adds no sorrow to it.
entries.declaration: I am worth far more than the birds my Father feeds, and my family eats well.
entries.verseText: Look at the birds of the air; they do not sow or reap or store away in barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?

entries.nameOfGod: The Owner of Silver and Gold
entries.attribute: The God who gives freely
entries.exaltation: The silver and the gold are Yours. You give freely.
entries.declaration: I declare God gives me power to produce wealth, and my increase confirms His covenant.
entries.verseText: But remember the Lord your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth, and so confirms his covenant, which he swore to your ancestors, as it is today.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Builds the House
entries.attribute: The God who watches the city
entries.exaltation: You build the house. You watch over the city.
entries.declaration: I am lending to many and borrowing from none, because God opens heaven over my work.
entries.verseText: The Lord will open the heavens, the storehouse of his bounty, to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands. You will lend to many nations but will borrow from none.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Calls Me by Name
entries.attribute: The God who knows me
entries.exaltation: You call me by name. I am Yours.
entries.declaration: I am loved by God without limit, and Christ proved it at the cross for me.
entries.verseText: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

entries.attribute: The God I am not overlooked by
entries.exaltation: You are the God who sees me. I am not overlooked.
entries.declaration: I declare God loved me first, and every ounce of love in me flows from His.
entries.verseText: We love because he first loved us.

entries.attribute: The God who wanted me first
entries.exaltation: You chose me before the world was made.
entries.declaration: I am God's beloved, and eternal life is mine because He gave His only Son.
entries.verseText: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.

entries.attribute: The God closer than a brother
entries.exaltation: You are the Friend who stays closer than a brother.
entries.declaration: I declare Jesus laid down His life for me, and no greater love exists anywhere.
entries.verseText: Greater love has no one than this: to lay down one's life for one's friends.

entries.attribute: The God who made me family
entries.exaltation: You adopted me. I belong to Your household forever.
entries.declaration: I am alive with Christ, raised by the great love of a God rich in mercy.
entries.verseText: But because of his great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy, made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in transgressions—it is by grace you have been saved.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Runs to Meet Me
entries.attribute: The God who does not wait
entries.exaltation: You run to meet me. You do not wait for me to arrive.
entries.declaration: I declare God sent His only Son for me, and I live every day through Him.
entries.verseText: This is how God showed his love among us: He sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Sets the Lonely in Families
entries.attribute: The God who gives me a people
entries.exaltation: You set the lonely in families. You give me a people.
entries.declaration: I am saved by the kindness and mercy of God, never by anything I earned.
entries.verseText: But when the kindness and love of God our Savior appeared, he saved us, not because of righteous things we had done, but because of his mercy.

entries.nameOfGod: The Shepherd Who Leaves the Ninety-Nine
entries.attribute: The God who came for one
entries.exaltation: You leave the ninety-nine for one. You came for me.
entries.declaration: I am loved with an everlasting love, and God draws me with kindness that never fails.
entries.verseText: The Lord appeared to us in the past, saying: 'I have loved you with an everlasting love; I have drawn you with unfailing kindness.'

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Engraved Me on His Hands
entries.attribute: The God who cannot forget me
entries.exaltation: You engraved me on the palms of Your hands.
entries.declaration: I declare the Father has lavished His love on me, and I am His child.
entries.verseText: See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are!

entries.attribute: The God who joined me to His own
entries.exaltation: You are the Head, and I am joined to Your body. I am not on my own.
entries.declaration: I am precious and honored in God's sight. He would trade nations for me.
entries.verseText: Since you are precious and honored in my sight, and because I love you, I will give people in exchange for you, nations in exchange for your life.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Whose Love Never Fails
entries.attribute: The God whose love has no condition
entries.exaltation: Your love never fails. It has no end and no condition.
entries.declaration: I am chosen, holy, and dearly loved. That love makes me gentle with people.
entries.verseText: Therefore, as God's chosen people, holy and dearly loved, clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Rejoices Over Me
entries.attribute: The God who is glad about me
entries.exaltation: You rejoice over me with gladness. You quiet me with Your love.
entries.declaration: I declare I belong to Jesus and He belongs to me, and nothing undoes that.
entries.verseText: I am my beloved's, and my beloved is mine; he browses among the lilies.

entries.attribute: The God who delights in me
entries.exaltation: You are the Bridegroom. You delight over me with singing.
entries.declaration: I declare God's love for me rises as high as the heavens above the earth.
entries.verseText: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is his love for those who fear him.

entries.attribute: The God who calls me family
entries.exaltation: You are the firstborn among many. You call me family.
entries.declaration: I declare the Lord is good, and His love runs through my whole family line.
entries.verseText: For the Lord is good and his love endures forever; his faithfulness continues through all generations.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Nothing Can Separate Me From
entries.attribute: The God who made me His own
entries.exaltation: You made me Your own. Nothing can separate me from Your love.
entries.declaration: I am surrounded by unfailing love, because my trust rests fully in the Lord.
entries.verseText: Many are the woes of the wicked, but the Lord's unfailing love surrounds the one who trusts in him.

entries.attribute: The God who heals
entries.exaltation: You are Jehovah Rapha. You are the God who heals.
entries.declaration: I am healed by His wounds, and this body carries the wholeness He paid for.
entries.verseText: But he was pierced for our transgressions, he was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was on him, and by his wounds we are healed.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Knit Me Together
entries.attribute: The God who knows this body
entries.exaltation: You knit me together. You know every part of this body.
entries.declaration: I declare Jesus carried it all in my place, so I walk in strength today.
entries.verseText: Surely he took up our pain and bore our suffering, yet we considered him punished by God, stricken by him, and afflicted.

entries.attribute: The God whose life is in me
entries.exaltation: You are the life-giver. Your life is in every part of me.
entries.declaration: I am healed, because Jesus bore it in His own body on that cross.
entries.verseText: He himself bore our sins in his body on the cross, so that we might die to sins and live for righteousness; by his wounds you have been healed.

entries.attribute: The God nothing is hidden from
entries.exaltation: You are the Great Physician. Nothing is hidden from You.
entries.declaration: I declare I live and do not die, and I tell what the Lord has done.
entries.verseText: I will not die but live, and will proclaim what the Lord has done.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Renews My Strength
entries.attribute: The God who lifts me up
entries.exaltation: You renew my strength. I rise up on wings like eagles.
entries.declaration: I declare Jesus took my weakness away, and strength rises in this body every morning.
entries.verseText: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: 'He took up our infirmities and bore our diseases.'

entries.nameOfGod: The Lord Who Forgives and Heals
entries.attribute: The God who does both
entries.exaltation: You forgive all my sin and heal all my disease.
entries.declaration: I declare the Lord answers me and heals me, and this body responds to His voice.
entries.verseText: Lord my God, I called to you for help, and you healed me.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Sends His Word and Heals
entries.attribute: The God whose word works
entries.exaltation: You send Your word and it heals. Your word never comes back empty.
entries.declaration: I am fearfully and wonderfully made, and every part of me works the way God designed.
entries.verseText: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.

entries.attribute: The God who rises with healing
entries.exaltation: You rise with healing in Your wings.
entries.declaration: I declare this body is the temple of the Holy Spirit, and He keeps it strong.
entries.verseText: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own; you were bought at a price. Therefore honor God with your bodies.

entries.attribute: The God who leaves nothing half done
entries.exaltation: You make whole. You leave nothing half done.
entries.declaration: I am prospering in soul, and my health prospers right along with it.
entries.verseText: Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well.

entries.attribute: The God who brings it back
entries.exaltation: You restore my health. You bring back what was taken.
entries.declaration: I am healed by the Lord, and every system in this body runs in perfect balance.
entries.verseText: Heal me, Lord, and I will be healed; save me and I will be saved, for you are the one I praise.

entries.attribute: The God whose breath is in me
entries.exaltation: You breathe, and life comes. Your breath is in me.
entries.declaration: I declare my healing appears quickly, and God's light breaks over this body like the dawn.
entries.verseText: Then your light will break forth like the dawn, and your healing will quickly appear; then your righteousness will go before you, and the glory of the Lord will be your rear guard.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Carried It All
entries.attribute: The God who took it in my place
entries.exaltation: You carried it all in Your own body. You left me nothing to carry.
entries.declaration: I declare the Spirit who raised Jesus lives in me and gives life to this body.
entries.verseText: And if the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, he who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies because of his Spirit who lives in you.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Whose Wounds Healed Me
entries.attribute: The God who already did it
entries.exaltation: By Your wounds I am healed. It is already done.
entries.declaration: I declare God made this body and called it very good, and I say the same.
entries.verseText: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Satisfies with Long Life
entries.attribute: The God who gives length of days
entries.exaltation: You satisfy me with long life and show me Your salvation.
entries.declaration: I declare the Lord is my strength and my shield, and my heart beats strong and steady.
entries.verseText: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me. My heart leaps for joy, and with my song I praise him.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Raises the Dead
entries.attribute: The God nothing is too far gone for
entries.exaltation: You raise the dead. Nothing is too far gone for You.
entries.declaration: I declare my heart is at peace, and that peace gives life to my whole body.
entries.verseText: A heart at peace gives life to the body, but envy rots the bones.

entries.attribute: The God who does not make mistakes
entries.exaltation: You are my Maker. You do not make mistakes.
entries.declaration: I declare God remade me in His likeness, and righteousness is who I am now.
entries.verseText: and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.

entries.attribute: The God whose hands made me
entries.exaltation: You are the Potter. I am the work of Your hands.
entries.declaration: I am moved into the kingdom of the Son God loves, and I belong to the light.
entries.verseText: For he has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of the Son he loves.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Delights in Me
entries.attribute: The God who settles who I am
entries.exaltation: You delight in me. That settles who I am.
entries.declaration: I am strong in the Lord. His mighty power moves through me.
entries.verseText: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power.

entries.attribute: The God who puts love on my head
entries.exaltation: You crown me with love and compassion.
entries.declaration: I am complete in Christ. Nothing in me is missing or unfinished.
entries.verseText: and in Christ you have been brought to fullness. He is the head over every power and authority.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Knew Me Before the Womb
entries.attribute: The God who set me apart
entries.exaltation: You knew me before You formed me. You set me apart.
entries.declaration: I declare my body is a temple, and the Holy Spirit Himself lives in me.
entries.verseText: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own.

entries.attribute: The God who wrote them first
entries.exaltation: You wrote all my days before one of them was.
entries.declaration: I am a friend of Jesus, not a servant. That is who I am.
entries.verseText: I no longer call you servants, because a servant does not know his master's business. Instead, I have called you friends, for everything that I learned from my Father I have made known to you.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Lifts the Lowly
entries.attribute: The God who seats me with princes
entries.exaltation: You lift the lowly and seat them with princes.
entries.declaration: I declare I received Jesus, so God gave me the right to be His child.
entries.verseText: Yet to all who did receive him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Gave Me a New Name
entries.attribute: The God the old name lost to
entries.exaltation: You gave me a new name. The old one has no hold.
entries.declaration: I am God's child and no longer a slave, and the whole inheritance is already mine.
entries.verseText: Because you are his sons, God sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, the Spirit who calls out, 'Abba, Father.' So you are no longer a slave, but God's child; and since you are God's child, God has made you also an heir.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Chose the Overlooked
entries.attribute: The God who always has
entries.exaltation: You choose the overlooked. You always have.
entries.declaration: I declare my righteousness is not my own, and it comes from God through faith.
entries.verseText: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own that comes from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ—the righteousness that comes from God on the basis of faith.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Finishes What He Starts
entries.attribute: The God who will complete me
entries.exaltation: You finish what You start. You will complete this in me.
entries.declaration: I am dressed in salvation and wrapped in a robe of righteousness by God Himself.
entries.verseText: I delight greatly in the Lord; my soul rejoices in my God. For he has clothed me with garments of salvation and arrayed me in a robe of his righteousness, as a bridegroom adorns his head like a priest, and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

entries.attribute: The God I stand in
entries.exaltation: You are my righteousness. I stand in Yours, not mine.
entries.declaration: I declare God chose me before the world was made and set me apart in love.
entries.verseText: For he chose us in him before the creation of the world to be holy and blameless in his sight. In love.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Whose Spirit Lives in Me
entries.attribute: The God who is greater
entries.exaltation: Your Spirit lives in me. Greater is He who is in me.
entries.declaration: I am God's treasured possession, chosen out of all the peoples on the earth.
entries.verseText: For you are a people holy to the Lord your God. The Lord your God has chosen you out of all the peoples on the face of the earth to be his people, his treasured possession.

entries.nameOfGod: The King Who Made Me His Own
entries.attribute: The God whose house I belong to
entries.exaltation: You are King, and You made me Your own.
entries.declaration: I am accepted in the Beloved. God welcomes me with open arms.
entries.verseText: to the praise of the glory of His grace, by which He made us accepted in the Beloved.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Calls Things That Are Not
entries.attribute: The God who speaks it into being
entries.exaltation: You call things that are not as though they already are.
entries.declaration: I am raised and seated with Christ, so I live from victory and not toward it.
entries.verseText: And God raised us up with Christ and seated us with him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Sees What I Already Am
entries.attribute: The God who sees the finished work
entries.exaltation: You see who I already am in You.
entries.declaration: I declare grace and righteousness pour over me, and through Jesus I reign in life.
entries.verseText: For if, by the trespass of the one man, death reigned through that one man, how much more will those who receive God's abundant provision of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man, Jesus Christ!

entries.attribute: God with me
entries.exaltation: You are Immanuel. God with me, right here.
entries.declaration: I declare I am born again into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ.
entries.verseText: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! In his great mercy he has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

entries.attribute: The God who turns His ear
entries.exaltation: You hear me. You turn Your ear to me.
entries.declaration: I am carrying Christ in me, the hope of glory, and my heart is His home.
entries.verseText: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

entries.attribute: The God who does not go
entries.exaltation: You never leave me. You never forsake me.
entries.declaration: I declare Christ has been raised from the dead, and my hope stands on solid ground.
entries.verseText: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins. But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Close to the Brokenhearted
entries.attribute: The God who is near
entries.exaltation: You are close to the brokenhearted. You are near.
entries.declaration: I am overflowing with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit living inside me.
entries.verseText: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

entries.attribute: The God who came to stay
entries.exaltation: You are the Comforter. You came to be with me and stay.
entries.declaration: I declare my hope is an anchor for my soul, firm and secure and never slipping.
entries.verseText: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. It enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain,

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Restores My Soul
entries.attribute: The God who leads me to still water
entries.exaltation: You restore my soul. You lead me beside still waters.
entries.declaration: I am waiting patiently for what I cannot see yet, and I expect it with full certainty.
entries.verseText: For in this hope we were saved. But hope that is seen is no hope at all. Who hopes for what they already have? But if we hope for what we do not yet have, we wait for it patiently.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Whose Mercies Are New
entries.attribute: The God faithful every morning
entries.exaltation: Your mercies are new every morning. Great is Your faithfulness.
entries.declaration: I am a prisoner of hope. God restores double back into my hands.
entries.verseText: Return to your fortress, you prisoners of hope; even now I announce that I will restore twice as much to you.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Keeps My Tears
entries.attribute: The God who wastes nothing
entries.exaltation: You keep every tear in Your bottle. Not one is wasted.
entries.declaration: I am certain there is a future hope for me, and it will not be cut off.
entries.verseText: There is surely a future hope for you, and your hope will not be cut off.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Sings Over Me
entries.attribute: The God who quiets me
entries.exaltation: You sing over me. You quiet me with Your love.
entries.declaration: I am joyful in hope, steady through every season. God's goodness gets the last word.
entries.verseText: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, faithful in prayer.

entries.attribute: The God who fills me
entries.exaltation: You are the God of hope. You fill me with joy and peace.
entries.declaration: I am putting my hope in God, and I will yet praise Him, my Savior and God.
entries.verseText: Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.

entries.attribute: The God I live in
entries.exaltation: You are my dwelling place. I live in You.
entries.declaration: I declare God's love is poured into my heart, and my hope stands firm and sure.
entries.verseText: And hope does not put us to shame, because God's love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, who has been given to us.

entries.attribute: The God morning always comes with
entries.exaltation: You are the bright morning star. Morning always comes.
entries.declaration: I am living inside God's plans for me, and they are plans for hope and a future.
entries.verseText: "For I know the plans I have for you," declares the Lord, "plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future."

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Is My Rest
entries.attribute: The God who carries it
entries.exaltation: You are my rest. In You I am not carrying it.
entries.declaration: I am certain nothing in my life is wasted, because God works it all for good.
entries.verseText: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Wipes Every Tear
entries.attribute: The God who ends it well
entries.exaltation: You will wipe every tear from my eyes.
entries.declaration: I declare God turns my whole story toward good, and many lives are saved through it.
entries.verseText: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good to accomplish what is now being done, the saving of many lives.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Walks With Me Through It
entries.attribute: The God in the fire
entries.exaltation: You walk with me through the fire. You do not send me alone.
entries.declaration: I am confident I see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.
entries.verseText: I remain confident of this: I will see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

entries.attribute: The God who tells me the way
entries.exaltation: You are my Counselor. You tell me which way to go.
entries.declaration: I am in Christ, and He Himself is my wisdom, so every answer is mine.
entries.verseText: It is because of him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God—that is, our righteousness, holiness and redemption.

entries.attribute: The God I see by
entries.exaltation: You are the Light of the World. In Your light I see.
entries.declaration: I declare every treasure of wisdom is hidden in Christ, and Christ lives in me.
entries.verseText: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

entries.attribute: The God who lights the next step
entries.exaltation: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
entries.declaration: I am Christ's, so the present and the future both belong to me and I plan boldly.
entries.verseText: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours: whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas, or the world or life or death, or things present or things to come—all are yours. And you are Christ's, and Christ is God's.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Gives Wisdom Generously
entries.attribute: The God who finds no fault
entries.exaltation: You give wisdom generously and without finding fault.
entries.declaration: I declare the cross is the power of God at work in me, and it never fails.
entries.verseText: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Orders My Steps
entries.attribute: The God who straightens the path
entries.exaltation: You order my steps. You make the path straight.
entries.declaration: I am clear and settled in my thinking, because I have the mind of Christ.
entries.verseText: for, "Who has known the mind of the Lord so as to instruct him?" But we have the mind of Christ.

entries.attribute: The God whose voice I know
entries.exaltation: You speak, and I know Your voice.
entries.declaration: I am led by the Spirit of God, and my steps land exactly where He aims them.
entries.verseText: For those who are led by the Spirit of God are the children of God.

entries.attribute: The God who guides me into all of it
entries.exaltation: You are the Spirit of Truth. You guide me into all truth.
entries.declaration: I declare I carry an anointing from the Holy One, and I know the truth on contact.
entries.verseText: But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Makes a Way
entries.attribute: The God who opens what is closed
entries.exaltation: You make a way where there is none.
entries.declaration: I am given the Spirit of wisdom and revelation, so I know God and see plainly.
entries.verseText: I keep asking that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you the Spirit of wisdom and revelation, so that you may know him better.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Reveals Deep Things
entries.attribute: The God who sees in the dark
entries.exaltation: You reveal deep and hidden things. You know what is in the dark.
entries.declaration: I am filled with the knowledge of God's will, and I know exactly what to do.
entries.verseText: For this reason, since the day we heard about you, we have not stopped praying for you. We continually ask God to fill you with the knowledge of his will through all the wisdom and understanding that the Spirit gives.

entries.attribute: The God everything lines up to
entries.exaltation: You are the cornerstone. Everything lines up to You.
entries.declaration: I am in awe of the Lord, and that awe is where my wisdom begins.
entries.verseText: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

entries.attribute: The God who misses nothing
entries.exaltation: Your understanding has no limit. You miss nothing.
entries.declaration: I declare I take advice and correction gladly, and it sharpens me into wisdom every time.
entries.verseText: Listen to advice and accept discipline, and at the end you will be counted among the wise.

entries.attribute: The God I trust it with
entries.exaltation: You hold tomorrow. I do not have to see it to trust You with it.
entries.declaration: I am the one who asks God for wisdom, and He pours it out freely.
entries.verseText: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to you.

entries.attribute: The God who knows the end
entries.exaltation: You are the Alpha and Omega. You already know the end.
entries.declaration: I declare wisdom comes straight from the mouth of God, and He gives it to me.
entries.verseText: For the Lord gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and understanding.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Is Never Confused
entries.attribute: The God who holds it together
entries.exaltation: You are never confused. You hold all of it together.
entries.declaration: I am guided by the Spirit of truth, and He shows me what is coming.
entries.verseText: But when he, the Spirit of truth, comes, he will guide you into all the truth. He will not speak on his own; he will speak only what he hears, and he will tell you what is yet to come.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Finishes the Story
entries.attribute: The God who ends it well
entries.exaltation: You are writing this, and You finish every story well.
entries.declaration: I declare the Spirit in me weighs every offer, and I know what is real.
entries.verseText: The person with the Spirit makes judgments about all things, but such a person is not subject to merely human judgments.

entries.attribute: The God whose washing holds
entries.exaltation: You make clean. What You wash stays washed.
entries.declaration: I am washed by the blood of Jesus. I stand justified and clean before God.
entries.verseText: But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.

entries.attribute: The God who ends the thirst
entries.exaltation: You are living water. I drink and I am never thirsty again.
entries.declaration: I declare Jesus made me whiter than snow, and my record before God is spotless.
entries.verseText: Come now, let us settle the matter, says the LORD. Though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they are red as crimson, they shall be like wool.

entries.attribute: The God who is what I actually want
entries.exaltation: You are the bread of life. You are what I actually want.
entries.declaration: I am walking in the light, and the blood of Jesus keeps me clean and open.
entries.verseText: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.

entries.attribute: The God of fullness of joy
entries.exaltation: You satisfy me. In Your presence is fullness of joy.
entries.declaration: I am cleansed in conscience by the blood of Christ, and I serve the living God.
entries.verseText: How much more, then, will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself unblemished to God, cleanse our consciences from acts that lead to death, so that we may serve the living God!

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Gives a New Heart
entries.attribute: The God who puts a new spirit in me
entries.exaltation: You give me a new heart. You put a new spirit in me.
entries.declaration: I declare my heart is pure, and I see God clearly with nothing in between.
entries.verseText: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.

entries.attribute: The God whose freedom is real
entries.exaltation: Whom You set free is free indeed.
entries.declaration: I am given a pure heart by God, and my spirit is steady and set on Him.
entries.verseText: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Washes Whiter Than Snow
entries.attribute: The God who leaves no stain
entries.exaltation: You wash me whiter than snow.
entries.declaration: I declare the Holy One calls me His own, and I am holy in all I do.
entries.verseText: But just as he who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do; for it is written: "Be holy, because I am holy."

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Renews My Mind
entries.attribute: The God whose thoughts become mine
entries.exaltation: You renew my mind. Your thoughts become mine.
entries.declaration: I am God's child, blameless and pure. I shine bright in a crooked world.
entries.verseText: So that you may become blameless and pure, children of God without fault in a warped and crooked generation.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Makes a Way Out
entries.attribute: The God who is faithful every time
entries.exaltation: You always make a way out. You are faithful.
entries.declaration: I am under grace, and my body answers to the Spirit of God in me.
entries.verseText: For sin shall no longer be your master, because you are not under the law, but under grace.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Broke Every Chain
entries.attribute: The God who says I am free
entries.exaltation: You broke every chain. I am free because You say so.
entries.declaration: I am brought from death to life, and every part of me serves righteousness now.
entries.verseText: Do not offer any part of yourself to sin as an instrument of wickedness, but rather offer yourselves to God as those who have been brought from death to life; and offer every part of yourself to him as an instrument of righteousness.

entries.attribute: The God who will do it
entries.exaltation: You sanctify me completely. You are faithful and You will do it.
entries.declaration: I am guarding my heart above all else, and everything I do flows clean from it.
entries.verseText: Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.

entries.attribute: The God nothing false survives
entries.exaltation: You are a consuming fire. Nothing false survives Your presence.
entries.declaration: I declare God gave me a new heart, soft and awake and alive to His voice.
entries.verseText: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you; I will remove from you your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.

entries.attribute: The God whose holiness is my gift
entries.exaltation: You are the Holy One. Holiness is Your gift to me.
entries.declaration: I am God's temple. His Spirit lives in me and never leaves.
entries.verseText: Don't you know that you yourselves are God's temple and that God's Spirit dwells in your midst?

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Restores Clean Hands
entries.attribute: The God who gives it back
entries.exaltation: You give back what was taken. You restore clean hands and a clean heart.
entries.declaration: I am serving God with a clear conscience, day and night, with nothing to hide.
entries.verseText: I thank God, whom I serve, as my ancestors did, with a clear conscience, as night and day I constantly remember you in my prayers.

entries.nameOfGod: The God Who Keeps Me from Falling
entries.attribute: The God who presents me blameless
entries.exaltation: You are able to keep me from falling and present me blameless.
entries.declaration: I am drawing near to God with a sincere heart and the full assurance faith brings.
entries.verseText: Let us draw near to God with a sincere heart and with the full assurance that faith brings, having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and having our bodies washed with pure water.
